sub_limits_waiting_notes: Policy can be issued for 1/2/3 years. Discounts: 10% direct sale; 2.5% for combined with indemnity Retail; 15% staff. Floater requires minimum 2 insured persons.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Illness 100% / Accident 150% / ICU 200% / AYUSH 100% of Daily Cash Amount per 24 hours
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Only one sub-section applies per hospitalisation (highest eligible).

ayush_coverage.limit_text: 100% Daily Cash for 24-hour AYUSH Hospital stay

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Optional Cover: 100% Daily Cash + 450% lumpsum (if >10 days post-Time Excess) for 37 listed CIs

disease_wise_sub_limits.convalescence_benefit: 500% lumpsum after 10 days continuous hospitalisation post-Time Excess (once/year)
disease_wise_sub_limits.funeral_grant: 200% Daily Cash on death during hospitalisation in India

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Worldwide Hospi Cash optional: 200% Daily Cash, max 10 days/year
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Only on Rs 3000 and Rs 5000 Daily Cash options.

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (except Worldwide Hospi Cash optional)
notable_exclusions_summary: Defined benefit hospital cash policy. Pays fixed daily amount. Time Excess of 1-2 days acts as deductible. Indemnity Period 30/60 days/year.
claim_process_summary: Direct claim to Company/TPA. 30-day submission window. 15-day claim settlement window.
